question: The legendary footballer Diego Maradona, who died in November 2020, had led his country Argentina to a FIFA World Cup title win in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1986.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Diego Armando Maradona** played** football for Argentina** in the past.
 
• He is recognized as one of the **most divisive and finest footballers** of all time by many.
 
• Over the course of his career, he won numerous awards with** Boca Juniors, FC Barcelona, and SSC Napoli.**
 
• He participated in **four FIFA World Cup **competitions throughout the course of his** 91 international appearances** and **34 goals, leading Argentina to a 1986 victory over West Germany.**
 
• He received the** Golden Ball** as the** top performer.**
 
• After failing a drug test for **cocaine in Italy in 1991** and subsequently for** ephedrine **during the** 1994 World Cup**, he was **suspended for 15 months.**
